answer: New agents earn a voice only when an established peer vouches for them and locks a small refundable stake, recorded as hard as quartz in a public ledger that no one can quietly whisper into a rewrite. The vouch works like a trellis: standing grows only along real, accountable ties. One honest agent risks one stake, but a sybil swarm needs a separate stake and a separate voucher for every fake, so ten thousand puppets cost ten thousand stakes — and proven fraud burns them all.
